semantics.identity: Observation and parent identifiers are decimal strings. Public labels and matching depths do not establish identity.
semantics.support: Drill depths are metres along the hole from collar. Point, interval, composite and unresolved support remain distinct.
semantics.azimuth: Degrees clockwise from true north in [0,360). Original 360-to-0 normalization is recorded in audit.
semantics.boreholeDip: Degrees from horizontal, negative downward; -90 down, 0 horizontal, +90 up.
semantics.chemistry: Numeric analyte columns carry half-limit substitutions for eligible below-limit results and reported lower bounds for above-limit results. Deliver assay metadata with values; preserve originals and calculation context.
semantics.extensions: Unpromoted attributes and repeated contextual occurrences are retained losslessly in JSONB. Flattened columns must preserve key identity and occurrence context.
semantics.surveySelection: Select whole runs using source hierarchy, otherwise most recent eligible source run date. Rank 1 is preferred; unresolved selection has no preferred run.
